name: io.github.aaronsb/slack-mcp
title: Slack
description: Read and write Slack with session tokens — no OAuth, no bot, no admin approval. Stealth reads leave unread state alone.

environmentVariables.name: SLACK_MCP_XOXC_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Slack session token. Optional — the auth-setup tool extracts it from your browser and stores it in the config file.

environmentVariables.name: SLACK_MCP_XOXD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Slack session cookie. Optional — the auth-setup tool extracts it from your browser and stores it in the config file.
